Confirmed the deliverables exist and re-ran the gates.

## Defects found and repaired (second verification pass)
Full re-reads of the seven strategies against the downloaded printed sources (Davis Appendix D.1–D.2, Lemma 6.6.8; Perrin §6.5) found three genuine mathematical errors, all now fixed:

1. **`thm-cg-tits-cone-interior-and-local-finiteness` (3)(iii)** — the wall argument assumed "every point of a wall `vH_{e_r}` is a limit of interior points of `vC`", which is false. Replaced with the correct argument: `f(α) ≠ 0` on every open chamber (W‑invariant signed-root computation), hence `H_α ∩ uC° = ∅`; a ball point lies in a wall `uH_{e_s}` of its chamber, and a finite cover of the open piece `H_α ∩ B` by proper affine subspaces is impossible — so `H_α = uH_{e_s}`. Transport sentence for general `f = w·f₀` rewritten accordingly.
2. **`ex-cg-tits-cone-of-infinite-dihedral-type` (iv)** — `r_s α_k = α_{k+1}` was miscomputed; correctly `r_s α_k = β_{k+1}`, `r_t β_k = α_{k+1}`, so `α_k, β_k ∈ Φ_+` follows by mutual induction.
3. **`ex-cg-outside-tits-cone-point-with-infinite-stabilizer` (iii)** — the displayed `s₂` action was the `s₁` formula (correct: `s₁:(−x₁,2x₁+x₂)`, `s₂:(x₁+2x₂,−x₂)`), and the closing contrast ("every point outside `U` has stabilizer ≤ 2") contradicted the cited example (nonzero boundary points are outside `U` with infinite stabilizer `⟨st⟩`); both corrected, now also noting `f` lies outside even `Ū`.
